details.text: Once you have your Mass Relocating Robot (Improve Weapons), you can now use it to improve some weapons, of which you'll find the list, depending of the type of your Mass Relocating Robot.
The best thing to do is compare, before the process: #L "Grandmaster Click Stabber" "152776", and afterward: #L "Much Improved Click Stabber" "157820".
